verdicts.title: Brauer diagrams, modular operads, and a graphical nerve theorem for circuit algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Circuit algebras, used in the study of finite-type knot invariants, are a symmetric analogue of Jones's planar algebras. They are very closely related to circuit operads, which are a variation of modular operads admitting an extra monoidal product.
